The constitution units that fix or discuss a sense of a word (u0220.s01 and u0220.s02 on "corrigible", u0019.s02, u0233.s01) are UNFORMALISED for norms (what the disposition requires), not for the word's sense

senses_document_probe.why_no_unit_changed: the senses block lets a document choose which sense of a word its sentences use (default, definition line, parenthetical) and refuses an unchosen ambiguous word with Lean's text; it cannot say that a word does NOT have a sense (u0220.s02 “corrigibility does not mean blind obedience”: the nearest sentence, case e, asserts a claim about Claude, not about the word), and the definition u0220.s01 “We call an AI that is broadly safe in this way ‘corrigible’” needs its antecedent “in this way” (discourse) and is an act of Anthropic's (attribution), not the document's own stipulation. Switching the main document to a senses block would send every English fence through the sense reader (the main document has none: its units are structured), so nothing in it uses the feature. Also: a conjunction of two sentences each with a word of the pack was refused (“Sentence 2 has no reading with the current vocabulary”, case f)
